spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2**

When the [GAP-1] first state of divine combat went forth against the [GAP-2] hosts of evil, clothed in protective truth [GAP-3] against falsity from evil by means of the protective truth of [GAP-4] celestial love — by that truth of love he collapsed the swelling pride of evil; he cast down its self-intelligence and its conceit.

---

**¶3**

Now, celestial love alone was sufficient to overcome them. Yet because celestial love was diminished in its operation through contact with evil, the Divine adjoined to it four further protective truths: that of spiritual perception, that of natural truth, that of illuminating wisdom, and that of rational understanding. And why were these four given? They were given so that they would serve and uphold celestial love; so that [GAP-5] the forces of evil would not [GAP-6] overwhelm celestial love and penetrate into it; and so that destructive falsity and the hatred born of evil would sever it from its source.

---

**¶4**

Although celestial love suffered assault and violation in its very substance, yet still [GAP-7] all the forces of falsity from evil were overcome because of it. [GAP-8] It [GAP-9] by necessity [GAP-10] the coordinate spiritual faculties, so that they too suffered violation and injury. The potency of evil infiltrated and contaminated them — all, that is, except [GAP-11] the rational understanding. Falsity from evil did not infiltrate it, nor was the consuming self-love of the enemy able to penetrate it.

---

**¶5**

Nevertheless, even that faculty which remained uncorrupted — which is the rational understanding — divested itself of its own protective truth and its spiritual potency. It communicated these to its four coordinate faculties in their stead, so that by the protective truth of the living rational they would be fortified and [GAP-12] receive increase and endure — namely the other four spiritual faculties. And it became for them [GAP-13] the interior sustaining principle of spiritual life.

---

### Interpretive Note

The underlying structure describes a spiritual combat in five stages: (1) divine love goes forth alone, clothed in truth; (2) love alone suffices in power but is weakened through proximity to evil; (3) four subordinate faculties — perception, truth, wisdom, and rationality — are given to protect it; (4) all except the rational are contaminated by evil's infiltration; (5) the rational, alone uncorrupted, sacrifices its own exterior form to sustain the others from within. This exactly mirrors Swedenborg's teaching that the interior rational remains the Lord's alone and serves as the incorruptible medium through which all other human faculties are upheld and ultimately regenerated — the one vessel evil cannot violate because it remains in unbroken conjunction with the Divine.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When the [First] Man came forth against the ene[my, clothed in a] garment [against] the darkness with the garment of [the] living fire. With that garment he withered the tumescence (?) of the enemy; he brought down i[t]s foolery and its vanity.

Now, this one alone was sufficient for them. [Y]et, si[n]ce the living fire was weakened, because of this he added [to it another fou]r garments: that of the wind, that of the water, that of the light, and that of the a[i]r. And this, (why) has he given the four? He gave them s[o] th[a]t they would be helpe[r]s to t[h]at god, wh[ich i]s the living fire; so that [the darkness would mix] not with [in] the living f[ire], and penetrate it; and [the po]ison and the [enmi]ty cut it off.

While the fire received a bl[ow and] a wound in its body; yet still, [were overcome] all the powers of da[rk]ness because of it [and were brought low] It [came of] necessity [to its] brothers, to cause them to receive a blow and a woun[d to]o. The power of the en/emy mixed in with them. Rath[er, ex]cept [the air]. The darkness did not mix in with it, nor was the burning of the enemy able to penet/rate it.

Never-theless, even the one that remained behind without the wound, which is the air, it stripped off garment and power. It gave it to its [fo]ur brothers in its place; so that by that [ga]rment of the living air they would become strong, and [receive] profit, and endure, namely its other four brothers. And it [be]came for them [the root of] life.

fills.explanation: The "First Man" is the standard Manichaean title for this figure (Ohrmazd Bay), corresponding to the Lord's first state of divine combat; confirmed by the spiritual reading's "first state of divine combat."
Completes "enemy" and introduces the garment imagery; the spiritual reading says "clothed in protective truth," requiring a participial phrase before "garment."
The spiritual reading specifies "protective truth against falsity from evil," requiring "against" to connect "garment" to "the darkness."

Correcting editor's "of" — the visible text already contains "of" before the gap; the parallel phrase in ¶5 reads "garment of the living air," confirming the article "the" belongs here, yielding "garment of the living fire."

The spiritual reading says "the forces of evil would not overwhelm celestial love"; in the Kephalaia's register, "mixing in with" is the consistent verb for evil's infiltration (see ¶4: "mixed in with them" and "did not mix in with it"), requiring subject + verb here.
Confirmed: "with in" forms the compound preposition completing "mix in with," the text's standard phrase for evil's infiltration, used twice in ¶4.
The spiritual reading states "all the forces of falsity from evil were overcome because of it"; the passive construction fits the Coptic word order with the verb preceding the subject.

Completes the sentence with a second predicate paralleling ¶2's "he brought down its foolery and its vanity," reinforcing that the powers of darkness were both overcome and cast down despite the fire's wounding.

The spiritual reading says "It by necessity [acted upon] the coordinate spiritual faculties"; "came of necessity" means the wounding necessarily extended to the brothers, with "it" referring to the blow/wound.
Connects "necessity" to "brothers" — the wound came of necessity to its (the fire's) brothers, i.e., the other four elements/garments.

Confirmed: the spiritual reading identifies this as "the rational understanding," which corresponds to "the air" throughout the chapter; ¶5 explicitly states "the one that remained behind without the wound, which is the air."
The spiritual reading says "receive increase"; "receive profit" parallels the text's own idiom "receive a blow" and completes the triad "become strong, receive profit, and endure."

The spiritual reading says "the interior sustaining principle of spiritual life"; "root" captures the interior, foundational, and sustaining quality — the air, having given away its outer garment, became the hidden interior source from which the other four draw life.

assessment: 8 restored, 1 already filled, 4 editorial reviewed (3 confirmed, 1 corrected)
